result.one_liner: Netlify is a web hosting and serverless platform for deploying static sites and applications with CI/CD, forms, and serverless functions.

evidence.quote: If you build or use an application that accesses the Netlify API as an OAuth app
Netlify Free plan is free forever with no financial risk
The base URL for API requests is https://api.netlify.com/api/v1

result.notes: Free tier includes full API access. Personal access tokens and OAuth applications both supported. REST API is primary interface with endpoints for sites, deploys, hooks, and more.
